episodes.title: Intro to Economics
episodes.description: Introduce economics as the study of people, decisions, and tradeoffs rather than simply money.

episodes.title: Specialization and Trade
episodes.description: Explore comparative advantage, production possibilities, and decisions about making goods or trading for them.

episodes.title: Economic Systems and Macroeconomics
episodes.description: Compare planned, market, and mixed systems and the choices individuals and countries make within them.

episodes.title: Supply and Demand
episodes.description: Explore how buyers and producers interact to influence prices and production.

episodes.title: Macroeconomics
episodes.description: Introduce economy-wide analysis through output, inflation, employment, taxation, and monetary decisions.

episodes.title: Productivity and Growth
episodes.description: Investigate differences in productivity and how economic output relates to everyday living standards.

episodes.title: Inflation and Bubbles and Tulips
episodes.description: Distinguish broad inflation from speculative price bubbles and explore how rising prices are tracked.

episodes.title: Fiscal Policy and Stimulus
episodes.description: Examine how government taxation and spending can influence economic activity.

episodes.title: Deficits & Debts
episodes.description: Distinguish borrowing from annual shortfalls and compare their implications for households and national governments.

episodes.title: What’s all the Yellen About? Monetary Policy and the Federal Reserve
episodes.description: Explore the Federal Reserve's role in using monetary measures to influence the economy.

episodes.title: Money and Finance
episodes.description: Distinguish currency from money and explore exchange, accounting, and storing value.

episodes.title: The 2008 Financial Crisis
episodes.description: Connect mortgage-based investments and a housing bubble with the financial collapse and government response in 2008.

episodes.title: Recession, Hyperinflation, and Stagflation
episodes.description: Investigate severe inflation, recession, and stagnation as problems facing national economies.

episodes.title: Economic Schools of Thought
episodes.description: Compare Keynesian ideas with socialist, communist, Austrian, and Chicago-school approaches.

episodes.title: Imports, Exports, and Exchange Rates
episodes.description: Connect specialization with international trade, exchange rates, and unequal outcomes among participants.

episodes.title: Globalization and Trade and Poverty
episodes.description: Weigh trade's overall benefits against losses experienced by particular workers and communities.

episodes.title: Income and Wealth Inequality
episodes.description: Distinguish income from wealth and explore debates over economic inequality and possible responses.

episodes.title: Marginal Analysis, Roller Coasters, Elasticity, and Van Gogh
episodes.description: Use marginal reasoning and price responsiveness to understand everyday and institutional choices.

episodes.title: Markets, Efficiency, and Price Signals
episodes.description: Explore price signals and the productive and allocation roles of markets.

episodes.title: Price Controls, Subsidies, and the Risks of Good Intentions
episodes.description: Investigate price ceilings, floors, subsidies, and the efficiency costs of well-intended interventions.

episodes.title: Market Failures, Taxes, and Subsidies
episodes.description: Explore situations where markets allocate poorly and how governments try to respond.

episodes.title: Environmental Econ
episodes.description: Treat pollution as an allocation problem and explore incentives and policies for reducing emissions.

episodes.title: Economics of Education
episodes.description: Examine education funding, differing quality, and the costs and possible returns of higher education.

episodes.title: Revenue, Profits, and Price
episodes.description: Distinguish revenue from profit and investigate business decisions about pricing.

episodes.title: Monopolies and Anti-Competitive Markets
episodes.description: Explore market dominance and compare harmful monopolies with industries where one supplier can be efficient.

episodes.title: Game Theory and Oligopoly
episodes.description: Use strategic reasoning to investigate competition among a small number of powerful firms.

episodes.title: Behavioral Economics
episodes.description: Explore how emotions, perceptions, and social pressures complicate models of rational consumer choice.

episodes.title: Labor Markets and Minimum Wage
episodes.description: Connect skills, demand, competing workers, and regulation with the wages people receive.

episodes.title: The Economics of Healthcare
episodes.description: Investigate why American health care costs so much and compare spending with outcomes elsewhere.

episodes.title: The Economics of Death
episodes.description: Explore the expenses and industries associated with care near life's end and funerals.

episodes.title: Taxes
episodes.description: Compare tax types, rates, brackets, and the public purposes financed by taxation.

episodes.title: The Underground Economy
episodes.description: Investigate exchanges outside official channels and how economists estimate otherwise hidden activity.

episodes.title: The Economics of Immigration
episodes.description: Explore economic evidence about immigration and the benefits attributed to movement across borders.

episodes.title: Foreign Aid and Remittance
episodes.description: Compare international assistance with money migrants send home and explore their economic and social effects.

episodes.title: The Economics of Happiness
episodes.description: Investigate connections between income, deprivation, location, and reported well-being.
